purpose: Verified per-dataset sagittal signs (rule B, target = sign x source) and per-recording exceptions (hold, or a sign correction approved by a backlog decision) consumed by contributor_tools/common/sign_application.py (CORE-11). Part of the bound build. An entry is used only when every task in audit_tasks is done in docs/maintainers/backlog.json and every one of those backlog records cites the entry id explicitly. Everything else falls back to the detector alone. A correction is applied only when every task in its audit_tasks is done and cites its id and its decision carries the recorded answer; otherwise its channels are held.
seeded: 2026-10-31, CORE-11 rounds 3-4, from the verified audits named per entry and the coordinator's round-4 rulings; no data read; AB04/i0 exception changed from hold to correct by UM21-P02 (D-UM21-P01-1 = C), no data read
omitted: UM21 powers: two storage layouts per recording (UM21-C03 kinetic_layout); a dataset-wide sign would be wrong for one layout. Detector alone.
GT21 and GT23 pelvis: not a sagittal tilt or not published.
GT21, GT23 and GT24 powers, GT24 knee moment: no verified audit of their sign.
GT24 hip moment: removed (coordinator ruling, round 4): its only data evidence is one family (CORE-04 stance timing) without a model definition behind it.
SIGN-SURVEY is not a verified backlog task and is not cited by any entry.
Segment angles (thigh, shank, foot): no audited per-dataset sign; detector alone.

exceptions.derivation: Rule B after sign application (sign_application.derive_segment_angles, SEGMENT_CHAIN): thigh = pelvis_tilt + hip_angle, shank = thigh - knee_angle, foot = shank + ankle_angle, from the hook's published channels, so the corrected tilt reaches all three. In source signs this is the UM21-C03 recipe family (thigh = hip - pelvis, shank = hip - pelvis - knee, foot = hip - pelvis - knee + ankle). The current MATLAB producers derive these columns from the stored pelvis before any sign handling (conversion_scripts/Umich_2021/convert_umich_time_to_parquet.m, thigh/shank/foot lines after choose_pelvis_signal; convert_umich_phase_to_parquet.m, 'enforces hip = thigh - pelvis' block); segment angles passed to the hook for AB04/i0 are held, never flipped.
exceptions.velocity_rule: pelvis_sagittal_velocity_rad_s and thigh/shank/foot_sagittal_velocity_{ipsi,contra}_rad_s of AB04/i0 are recomputed after the hook with sign_application.derive_angular_velocities from the published pelvis tilt and the derive_segment_angles outputs (same differentiation as the UM21 converters, MATLAB gradient; see VELOCITY_METHOD), or left out. The converters' own velocities are built from the stored (reversed) pelvis: pelvis sagittal velocity has the wrong sign and segment velocities carry 2 x d(tilt)/dt. Velocity inputs passed to the hook are held.
